name: code-puppy-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Code Puppy, a Python command-line coding agent. Besides the agent itself it
contains the supporting layers the command line is built on: a small internationalization package that
resolves the user's locale and renders translated, pluralized messages from JSON catalogs, the message bus
and terminal output layer, a hook engine that runs user-configured commands around tool calls, the plugin
loader and the callback registry that plugins hook into.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this part of the repository.
Everything in scope is code_puppy's internationalization package (code_puppy/i18n/, including its locale catalogs), its message bus and terminal output layer (code_puppy/messaging/), its hook engine (code_puppy/hook_engine/), its plugin loader (code_puppy/plugins/) and its callback registry (code_puppy/callbacks.py), together with docs/I18N.md, docs/HOOKS.md, AGENTS.md, code_puppy/hook_engine/README.md and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
